sections.title: Overview
sections.html_content: An iPhone application aimed at treating obsessive-compulsive behavior through exposure therapy. Patients would receive push notifications with curated "triggers" to help mitigate negative impact.

sections.title: Role
sections.html_content: I did UX design work and product roadmapping for the client which could then be used in hiring a developer to build out the application.

sections.title: Initial Objectives
sections.html_content: Client in St. Louis, MO, reached out for help taking existing low-quality, low-fidelity mockups and figuring out roadmap and budget for building a functional application.

sections.title: Solution
sections.html_content:
I took the existing mockups and redid them using standard SwiftUI / UIKit elements to support easier development and better usability.

I broke down key functional requirements into epics and features and developed an iterative roadmap with key milestones and effort estimates.

sections.title: Impact
sections.html_content: Client was extremely impressed and satisfied by both design work and roadmap clarity and used generated artifacts to hire an independent developer to build the app.
